title: Staff Bridge — Tactical Blockers & Escalations (2026-05-20)
content:
Attendees: Aisha (chair), Marcus, Olivia, Diego, Priya, Elena (observability), Samir (SRE - oncall)

Agenda:
- Quick wins / status updates (5m)
- High-priority blockers and escalations (25m)
- Dedicated rollout: capacity and SLA gating (15m)
- On-call handoff & playbook gaps (10m)
- Action item review + next steps (5m)

Notes / Decisions:
1) KV cache mis-replay (INF-5421) — root cause narrowed to race in compacted cache invalidation. Marcus has a hotfix branch (PR #789) that reduces window; QA to validate replay under load. Decision: ship hotfix to staging by 2026-05-22, run 48h traffic soak. If no regressions, schedule production rollout 2026-05-25 with canary at 10% traffic.

2) Dedicated autoscaler oscillation (INF-5478) — observed during synthetic load tests; suspected threshold hysteresis is too tight. Diego to prototype hysteresis bump + add smoothing window. Temporary mitigation: cap autoscale down to minimal nodes for customer beta til fix verified.

3) Private deployment onboarding checklist gaps — highlighted by recent customer onboarding that hit network policy mismatch. Priya and Olivia to update private-deployments checklist in Confluence (page linked) to include explicit VPC subnet and MTU checks. Also add KMS walkthrough for rotating keys.

4) SLO regression alert noise — Elena reported a spike in false positives from p50 latency alerts after a logging agent change. Action: Elena to pin agent version on prod worker image and tune alert playbooks; Samir to run a purge of stale alert rules and post updated runbook in #sre-runbooks by EOD 2026-05-21.

5) Capacity ask for Canary week (2026-05-25 to 2026-05-29) — platform needs +3 T4s in us-west-2 for canaries and soak. Finance pre-approved temporary burst; Marcus to file a cloud request with cost estimate by 2026-05-21.

Action Items (owner / due):
- Marcus: merge hotfix PR #789 to staging and coordinate 48h soak (due 2026-05-22) [JIRA INF-5421].
- Diego: implement hysteresis + smoothing prototype, bench results to staff (due 2026-05-24) [JIRA INF-5478].
- Priya & Olivia: update Private deployment onboarding checklist and KMS rotation steps on Confluence (due 2026-05-23).
- Elena: pin logging agent, tune p50 alerts, publish updated runbook in #sre-runbooks (due 2026-05-21).
- Marcus: submit cloud capacity request for canary week with cost breakdown (due 2026-05-21).
- Samir: coordinate oncall rotation for Memorial Day week and ensure two backups are assigned (due 2026-05-22).

Risks / Notes to leadership:
- If KV cache hotfix regresses, rollback path is validated but will add 6–8h of mitigation time; have escalation contacts on standby (Marcus, Diego, Samir).
- Autoscaler fix timeline is tight; if prototype needs more cycles, plan to extend beta with customer consent.
- Private onboarding checklist changes are high leverage for future deals — request product solutions time to review updated copy.

Parking Lot / Follow-ups:
- Larger discussion on token-cost optimization (batching + quantization policy) to be moved to next week’s staff-bridge; product & optimize reps to be invited.
- Request for a quarterly tabletop incident drill for Dedicated customers — proposal due 2026-06-04.

Next meeting: 2026-05-27 10:00am PT (staff-bridge). Please update linked JIRA tickets and Confluence notes ahead of meeting.

Quick wins reported (1–2 min each):
- Priya: onboarding pilot completed for ACME Corp; minor network tweaks only.
- Olivia: private deploy KMS proof-of-concept passed basic encrypt/decrypt flow.
- Diego: bench harness updated to run 200 concurrent contexts (speeds up repro by 3x).

References: JIRA INF-5421 (KV cache), JIRA INF-5478 (autoscaler), PR: github.com/redwood-inference/realtime-runtime/pull/789, Confluence onboarding checklist page.
